findings.detail: Builds interactive visualizations and term rankings from an already trained LDA model rather than fitting the topic model.
Renders existing Mass2Motif distributions as interactive bubble plots without learning motifs from a spectral corpus.
Constructs the fragment-and-neutral-loss input corpus and document mapping for a downstream trainer rather than performing LDA inference.
Maps known-compound MS/MS peaks to fragments of a supplied molecular graph rather than assigning substructure labels to inferred Mass2Motifs.
Annotates Mass2Motif pseudo-spectra by fragment-based reference matching but does not implement the requested MotifDB and Spec2Vec MAG procedure.
Retrieves and filters motif-document summaries and exports motif-mapped network tables but does not consolidate motif composition, substructure labels and confidence into the requested report.
